skill.name: ClickUp Integration Expert
skill.description: Guide ClickUp roadmap synchronization through the official ClickUp MCP, including setup, mapping, sync commands, status checks, and conflict rules.
skill.summary: Map local epics and milestones to ClickUp tasks, then guide pull, push, sync, and status workflows.
skill.author: AndresNaza

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around paths, JSON examples, and slash commands. One documented CLI setup command and the hardcoded ClickUp MCP URL are real user-consent risks for adding a remote MCP integration.

remediation.issue: The MCP setup command changes local Claude MCP configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to verify the ClickUp MCP endpoint and approve the configuration change before running the command.

remediation.issue: The OAuth authentication step does not describe requested ClickUp access.
remediation.suggestion: Document the expected OAuth permissions and how users can revoke ClickUp access after testing.

remediation.issue: Markdown slash commands and examples create noisy external command detections.
remediation.suggestion: Label slash commands as Claude command examples and separate them from shell command instructions.

content.value_statement: Teams often lose roadmap context when ClickUp and local planning files drift apart. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through mapping, sync, status, and conflict checks.
actual_capabilities: Maps local epics to ClickUp tasks and milestones to subtasks.
Explains the expected ClickUp workspace, space, folder, and sync mapping configuration.
Lists setup, push, pull, full sync, status, link, and unlink workflows.
Guides MCP setup using the ClickUp remote MCP endpoint.
Defines conflict rules for status, points, and title fields.
limitations: Requires the official ClickUp MCP and a successful OAuth login.
Does not include executable sync scripts or a complete API client.
Depends on existing roadmap files and ClickUp workspace structure.
Does not define every ClickUp field mapping or permission scope.

use_cases.title: Keep Product Roadmaps Aligned
use_cases.description: Synchronize local epic and milestone planning with ClickUp tasks while preserving clear conflict rules.

use_cases.title: Review Sync Health
use_cases.description: Check current sync status before changing roadmap items or updating ClickUp tasks.

use_cases.title: Set Up ClickUp MCP Access
use_cases.description: Configure the ClickUp MCP endpoint and understand the OAuth authentication step before syncing.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what I need before syncing my local roadmap with ClickUp using this skill.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A One Way Push
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare to push local epics and milestones into ClickUp. Include what to verify first.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Local And Remote Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through a pull before push workflow so I can review ClickUp changes before updating the roadmap.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Sync Conflicts
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my roadmap sync conflict rules and recommend how to handle status, points, and title differences.

output_examples.input: I need to sync my roadmap with ClickUp for the first time.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline MCP setup, OAuth authentication, workspace selection, folder mapping, and a first status check before syncing.

output_examples.input: ClickUp and my local roadmap both changed. What should I do?
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend pulling remote changes first, reviewing differences, then applying the documented conflict rules before pushing updates.

output_examples.input: How should epics and milestones map into ClickUp?
output_examples.output: The skill would map epics to ClickUp tasks and milestones to subtasks under the related epic.

best_practices: Pull remote ClickUp changes before pushing local roadmap updates.
Use a dry run or status review before any full bidirectional sync.
Confirm workspace, space, folder, and OAuth access before linking items.
anti_patterns: Do not push local changes before checking whether ClickUp was updated by others.
Do not authenticate the MCP connection without verifying the ClickUp endpoint.
Do not treat conflict rules as universal for every ClickUp field.

faq.question: Does this skill install the ClickUp MCP automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents the command users can run after they decide to add the ClickUp MCP.

faq.question: Does it require ClickUp authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup flow requires OAuth authentication through the ClickUp MCP.

faq.question: Can it sync both directions?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflows include push, pull, and full bidirectional sync commands.

faq.question: What local items does it map to ClickUp?
faq.answer: It maps epics to ClickUp tasks and milestones to subtasks under those epics.

faq.question: How are conflicts resolved?
faq.answer: The skill states that ClickUp wins for status, while local planning wins for points and title.

faq.question: Is it a full ClickUp API client?
faq.answer: No. It is guidance for a ClickUp MCP based roadmap sync workflow.
